verdict.rationale: The Snyk CLI is documented to run in CI/CD pipelines, and Snyk ships an organization-level role template so CI/CD service accounts can run `snyk test` and `snyk monitor` non-interactively. Docs also cover build-time report generation and non-interactive scan commands (`snyk test`, `snyk code test`, `snyk secrets test`). missing for 10: documented headless authentication (e.g. token/env-var setup), machine-readable output formats and exit-code semantics for gating, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can also run the CLI in your CI/CD pipeline.
This Organization-level role allows service accounts in CI/CD pipelines to run basic Snyk CLI commands.
The role grants permissions to run `snyk test` to check Projects for vulnerabilities and `snyk monitor`
To help generate reports locally or at build time, see the [snyk-to-html plugin]
providing actionable insights directly in the developer workflow across IDEs, repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
Use the `snyk secrets test` command to run a secrets scan from the command line.
